hooks.commandWindows: powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "`$msg = 'Before acting on this request, review available Cartograph (cg-*) skills and use any that apply.'; `$payload = [ordered]@{ systemMessage = `$msg; hookSpecificOutput = [ordered]@{ hookEventName = 'UserPromptSubmit'; additionalContext = `$msg } }; `$payload | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5 -Compress; exit 0"
